verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ALERUUYA myimbe,
Leero Yesu-azuukidde,
Tuyimbe nga twebaza
Olw'okuwangula kwe.
Aleruuya

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Obulumi bw'okufa,
N'amaanyi gaakwo gonna,
Byonna abiwangudde:
Naffe ka tujaguze.
Aleruuya

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naffe-abaali-abasibe
Mu buddu obwekibi
Leero naffe tusinza:
Ssetaani awanguddwa.
Aleruuya

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ka tujaguze fenna
Kubanga yawangula;
Ka tuyimbe-amatendo
Kuba tuli ba ddembe.
Aleruuya.
